description:
Tired of towns expanding along your highways, or right up to the roads beside your train tracks? Want to stop a town growing towards the nearby farm or forest? Or just control which roads buildings can face?

Then this is the mod for you!

Behind the scenes it's the noise barrier without the… barrier… and the noise reduction. It does stop towns from spawning buildings along the marked side of the road. Towns can still upgrade or extend the road unless you also lock it with the default Locking Tool.

It costs the same to build as a noise barrier, including demolition of any affected buildings (in my head, the "construction price" is the cost of the associated bureaucracy).

Uninstalling: this is technically an asset mod. Remove it from every road in every save before uninstalling.

name: Don't expand there
summary: Keep town buildings away from specific roads.
